properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): operator evidence HAS an honest home (a check with method `observation`, kind `validation`, performed in a production environment), and it proves the capability. But a stale check leaves loop_status attention only through its own status: the digest filters on status alone, rerun_owed compares a repair's date with that check's own last run, and nothing relates other evidence to it. A `parks` ruling from an accepted decision does not move it either. So "re-run owed" stands forever on a system in daily use. This is the THIRD shape of the one-status class
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-28, triaging art:hxm-program-feedback-2026-09-28 (hxm_program hub, 2026-09-28, reflow2 0.73.0) under rule:field-feedback-issues-are-root-caused-and-ideas-are-brainstormed. Item F-32.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words: "Operator attestation has no evidence grade. 'It has run in user operations for 11 days with no complaint' is real evidence, weaker than a re-run and much stronger than nothing. Today the only honest encodings were: leave the check `failing` with `rerun_owed: true` forever (what I did); or mark it `passing` (a lie about what was observed). The check will now sit in `loop_status` attention indefinitely, and `/where` will keep reporting 'a re-run is owed' on a system everyone agrees is working." The same report praises INVALIDATES for that very check: "its last run failed, a repair postdates it, and a re-run is owed ... This is the right semantics, and it is rare." EXPECTED: a way to say "closed on operator evidence, not re-run" that the rollups read. NOT AFFECTED: the INVALIDATES reading itself (correct, and praised).

② PRECEDENT, searched on the raw words ("operator attestation evidence grade run in user operations no complaint rerun owed"; "observation method field watching it run unchanged verification evidence production environment"). SAME CLASS, recorded today: fact:root-cause-a-run-has-one-status-and-its-qualification-reaches-no-rollup-2026-09-28. A run has one machine-read outcome and every rollup reads only that; it was sighted as partly-blocked (qs, 2026-09-04) and expected-change (dev_storyflow, 2026-09-25). Open ideas: dec:idea-a-run-can-pass-with-its-exceptions-stated and dec:idea-a-finding-carries-its-bounds (which proposes a `grade`). Governing design: cap:a-repair-can-say-what-it-invalidated: "it never says the check now passes, never touches the target's status, and never removes the check from attention". Adjacent: cap:evidence-fidelity (proof against a model vs against reality), and fact:three-of-eight-reported-verification-gaps-were-already-built (reported verification gaps are often already built).

③ CANDIDATES, from the bones:
(A) SCHEMA / ASSURANCE: a check has one status and no evidence grade, and the rollups read only status. This is the reporter's reading and the class above.
(B) DISCOVERABILITY, the observation is wrong: an honest encoding of operator evidence already exists and was missed. Verification.method has `observation` ("watching it run in the field, unchanged"), kind can be `validation`, and PERFORMED_IN can name a production Environment.
(C) READER DESIGN: rerun_owed and attention read only the stale check's OWN fields, so no other record (another check, a ruling) can answer it, whatever it says.
(D) GOVERNANCE: an owner's ruling that operator evidence suffices could park the check (GOVERNED_BY ruling: parks), and the reporter did not try it.

④ WHAT SEPARATES THEM: (B) predicts that an observation check both proves the capability AND takes the stale check out of attention. (C) predicts it proves the capability while the stale check stays listed. (D) predicts a parks ruling from an accepted decision removes it. (A) predicts no field on either check carries the grade.

⑤ RESULTS, reflow2-mcp 0.74.0, scratch store. A capability; a scripted end-to-end check `failing`, last_run_at 2026-09-10; a fix dated 2026-09-17 INVALIDATES it.
· Baseline loop_status: the check is in attention with rerun_owed true and the note "THE VERDICT BELOW PREDATES IT — re-run before quoting it as current". unproven_capabilities 1.
· Added a second check: method observation, kind validation (set_verification_kind; add_verification does not take `kind`), status passing, last_run_at 2026-09-28, findings "operator: in operations, no issues, 11 days", PERFORMED_IN an Environment with env_type production. Result: unproven_capabilities 1 → 0; evidence_report gives independently_verified true, proven_in [the production environment], simulation_only false. BUT the scripted check stays in attention, rerun_owed true, unchanged. ⇒ (B) PARTLY HOLDS: the evidence has an honest home that reaches the capability-level rollups, and the reporter did not use it. It does NOT answer the stale check. (C) HOLDS.
· Accepted Decision "operator evidence closes the stale check" (approver named), then GOVERNED_BY ruling: parks from the scripted check. attention unchanged. ⇒ (D) REFUTED: parks is read by the structural detectors, not by the verification digest (coherence.rs builds attention from `status != passing && != superseded`).
· reconcile_verification (look only) reporting `passed` against the scripted check returns a divergence ("recorded as 'failing' and the run reported 'passed'"). With record_events it would open drift. It is also untrue: the scripted check was not run.
· The only exits from attention are `passing` (the lie the reporter refused) and `superseded`, which retires the scripted check. That is wrong when the owner still wants a real run to upgrade it (the report's O-19: "a real run upgrades it").
· Schema: Verification has no grade field; method, kind, level and status are the only axes. ⇒ (A) HOLDS.

⑥ CLASS: a check's standing is one status field, and every rollup reads it from the check alone. Qualified outcomes (qs), intended changes (dev_storyflow) and now weaker evidence from elsewhere (hxm) all have to be written as prose or as a separate node that no rollup joins back. Would a class fix have covered all three? Only one that gives rollups a structured way to state and read a qualifier, or a relation between a stale check and the evidence answering it. A new status word would not, for the reason the qs record gave: it owes every reader a ruling. So this is the third sighting, from a third project, in a third shape.

⑦ OUT OF SCOPE; no code changed. A test pinning the class, whose form waits on the owner's ruling on dec:idea-a-check-closes-at-a-stated-evidence-grade-under-an-owner-set-rule and its two siblings, would assert:
(i) a stale check answered by recorded evidence of another kind is reported with that answer and its grade, not only "re-run owed";
(ii) a real run of the stale check still supersedes that answer;
(iii) no rollup counts the answer as a plain pass without saying so.
(i) and (iii) fail today.

REPORTER'S CONCLUSIONS. HELD: "no evidence grade"; "sit in loop_status attention indefinitely"; the /where consequence, since where-am-i quotes attention via invalidated_findings. QUALIFIED: "the only honest encodings were" failing-forever or passing. A third honest encoding exists: a separate observation check in production. It proves the capability to evidence_report and clears the unproven-capability gap. It does not close the stale check, which is the part of the complaint that stands.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: what the hub actually recorded beyond the INVALIDATES edge (the hub's design was not read); whether /where on 0.73.0 words it exactly as quoted (inferred from where-am-i reading invalidated_findings, not replayed); how many checks across designs sit in this state.
